Article title: Isaac Fisher - Blog

Article text:
random-bench / Benchmarks are Astrology for LLMs
Benchmarks are a hot topic lately. Every other week, some new model has achieved some incredible number on a benchmark I've never seen before. I, personally, am tired of the benchflation pioneered by certain reckless frontier AI companies. Although they're often marketing nonsense, leakage is probably real, and “rogue” agent cheating is more common than ever, there's a certain mystical appeal to benchmarks, and they do generally signal improvement, give or take. While they may not be perfect (or, in some cases, meaningful in real-world contexts at all), you can learn quite a bit about models from their performances on even arbitrary tasks. When we talk about AI in industry, most people mistake these terms as a problem tied directly to the software development industry. But by far AI has had a much more important impact on every aspect of our lives, not everything revolves around developers and Big Tech.
